input: Get a mole checked at the dermatologist

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether the user already has a dermatologist or needs to find one entirely changes the first steps of the plan.
Insurance coverage or out-of-pocket cost tolerance affects which providers are viable options.
How soon the user wants the appointment determines urgency and whether walk-in/urgent options need to be considered.
Whether this is a routine skin check or a specific concerning mole shapes how urgently and how broadly the appointment should be framed.
Whether a GP referral is required (e.g. in certain health systems) affects the sequence of steps before booking the dermatologist.
Preferences for appointment format (in-person vs. teledermatology) and location affect which providers to target.
Knowing what outcome the user wants (peace of mind, a biopsy if needed, a written report) defines what a successful appointment looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Get a mole checked at the dermatologist
gold.taskDescription: Book and attend a dermatologist appointment to have a mole professionally examined.

questions.title: Do you already have a dermatologist you see?
questions.description: Determines whether the user needs to find and vet a new provider or simply schedule with an existing one.

questions.title: Is this mole new, changing, or just a routine check?
questions.description: Clarifies the medical urgency and how the appointment should be framed when booking.

questions.title: How soon do you want to be seen?
questions.description: Establishes the time horizon so the plan can prioritise speed (urgent care, cancellation lists) or standard scheduling.

questions.title: Does your health system require a GP referral first?
questions.description: In some countries or insurance plans a referral is mandatory; this determines whether a GP visit is step one.

questions.title: Will you be using insurance, and do you have a preferred network?
questions.description: Insurance status and network constraints narrow down which dermatologists are affordable and eligible.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person visit or would teledermatology work?
questions.description: Appointment format preference filters the type of providers and platforms to consider.

questions.title: What outcome would make this appointment feel complete to you?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user wants verbal reassurance, a biopsy if warranted, or a written report defines what a successful visit looks like.
